text:
Predicates:
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
MountainRange(y) ::: y is a mountain range.
LocatedIn(y, z) ::: y is located in z.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
In(z, y) ::: z is in y.

Premises:
PicurisMountains(y) ∧ In(y, NewMexico) ∨ In(y, Texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(JuanDeOnate, y) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(hamiltonPegmatiteMine) ∧ LocatedIn(hamiltonPegmatiteMine, y) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is located in the Picuris Mountains.
Donated(hamiltonPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine was donated.
¬∃x (Mine(x) ∧ Donated(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, Texas)) ::: No mines in Texas have been donated.

Conclusion:
Visited(JuanDeOnate, y) ∧ In(y, Texas) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
